title: Term evaluation
statement: For a dimension $n$, let a term be a finite list of literals with pairwise distinct coordinates. On an input $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$, its value is $-1$ exactly when every listed literal has value $-1$, and is $+1$ otherwise; in particular, the empty term has value $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: the term's literal coordinates are pairwise distinct
